cross_references.relationship: MICRA_LATTICE — §3333.2 caps noneconomic damages but does NOT cap punitive damages. A plaintiff who clears §425.13 and proves §3294 malice/oppression/fraud can recover punitive damages on top of the capped noneconomic award. The Hrimnak escape removes both the §3333.2 cap AND the §425.13 gate simultaneously for true intentional tort claims.

PARALLEL_TRACK — Prior Medical Board discipline or pending Board complaint is evidence supporting the §425.13 motion (pattern of conscious disregard). File Board complaint early to generate discoverable record.

LATTICE — §3333.1 collateral source rule and §425.13 punitive gate both affect the damages calculation. Punitive damages are separate from compensatory damages; §3333.1 affects the compensatory side, not punitive.

APPLICATION — SIRVA case: §425.13 applies if claim is professional negligence framing. Evidence for motion: Walgreens' training records + prior SIRVA complaints at that location + injector's technique documentation.
